name: Notion AI (www.notion.so)

capabilities.name: Notion AI chat
capabilities.description: Open /ai (or a workspace page's Notion AI) and send a prompt; answer renders in the AI chat thread. Same-origin eventName-RPC transport (POST /api/v3/<eventName>) with model orange-mousse; streaming transport UNVERIFIED.
capabilities.method: ui-path (trusted input + Enter, site's own send handler)

capabilities.name: Workspace Q&A
capabilities.description: Ask across connected workspace sources on /ai (Q&A model orange-mousse, promptCategory filter); exact request body NOT statically recoverable — live shape to verify.

capabilities.name: In-page AI commands
capabilities.description: Inline AI commands (Improve writing, Summarize, etc.) on workspace pages; ai_writer / create_form / db_agent settings tabs — flag literals in bundle, exact command list TO-VERIFY.
capabilities.method: site UI toggle (ai_writer flag); live command set TO-VERIFY

capabilities.name: AI search tool
capabilities.description: injectSearchTool flag / targetConfig types=[search, researcher] / promptCategory=deep_research — grounded flags, live search flow TO-VERIFY.

capabilities.name: QnA source connectors
capabilities.description: Manage external source ingestions (google_drive_qna_ingestion, jira_qna_ingestion_v2, github_qna, gmail_ai_connector, etc.) under aicustomagents/aiconnectors* — connector map grounded in bundle, UI shapes TO-VERIFY.
capabilities.method: site settings UI (aicustomagents/aiconnectors*); live shapes TO-VERIFY

auth.note: provider-catalog: notion-web kind=cookie (token_v2 required; optional space_id, notion_browser_id). Bundles: token_v2 read via getCookieWithoutPermissionCheck; api:{http:'/api/v3'} (module 96265); /api/v3/authValidate literal confirms same-origin cookie auth (no Bearer token observed). Capture once headed, then fill session.lock.json. getAnswer/enrichedAIGenerate NOT in downloadable bundles — live capture needed to recover the chat-request method.

analysisMethod: static curl + ~30 JS bundles under /_assets/ (~8 MB) + nt.html/nt-login.html app shells; no browser launched
